description: This file contains shell script functions for upgrading eMMC storage devices in an OpenWrt environment. The functions handle tarball and FIT images for firmware upgrades, manipulate device partitions, and perform data copying and device initialization tasks.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Performs eMMC upgrade using a tar archive, extracting kernel, root filesystem, and DTB, and writing them to appropriate devices.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Handles eMMC upgrade using a FIT image by extracting and writing the kernel image.

methods.name: emmc_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data from a backup file to eMMC devices.

methods.name: emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function that determines the file type (tar or fit) and invokes the corresponding upgrade process.
